'''Jakker-Sun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was present when [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] led a [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|raid]] on the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and was held hostage along with other senators.

{{Char-stub}}

==Biography==
During the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Senate hostage crisis]], Jakker-Sun along with other [[Senator/Legends|senators]] was taken hostage by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], who wanted to exchange their freedom for the release of [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]]. When the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] was freed, Cad Bane and his team set charges in the room the senators were held in and left the building. Once safely away, Bane detonated the charges, but Jakker-Sun and the other senators were saved by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who managed to get them to a safe distance right before the explosion.
